## The challenge

## Small changes, shipped often

Every change takes a clear path from idea to release, and everyone can see where it is.

## See the whole picture

![A map of connected work](data:image/png;base64,)

One shared view keeps the team aligned, from the first sketch to the release notes.

## Follow the work

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Idea --> Build --> Review --> Release

%% play: From idea to release
%% Idea -> Build | Turn an idea into a small change.
%% Build -> Review | Invite the team to review it.
%% Review -> Release | Ship it and share the result.
```

## Make the next step easy

- **Start small** Pick one change you can finish this week.
- **Show the work** Keep progress visible to the whole team.
- **Share early** Ask for feedback before the details set.
